item.text: {"search_note":"I found no direct 2024 evidence of a sweeping Srettha-led overhaul of competition law, anti-monopoly enforcement, or domestic property-rights reform for Thai entrepreneurs. The clearest evidence is concentrated in trade deals, investment promotion, financial-hub regulation, and selective real-estate liberalization.","evidence":[{"title":"World Bank Outlines Five Reform Priorities for Thailand to Revitalize Growth","publisher":"World Bank","date":"March 25, 2024","url":"https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/03/25/world-bank-outlines-five-reform-priorities-for-thailand-to-revitalize-growth","summary":"The World Bank’s 2024 Thailand reform agenda explicitly called for a more competitive and innovative economy, stronger competition regulations, support for SMEs, and stronger fiscal institutions. This is direct evidence for pro-trade, pro-investment rulemaking.","question_ids":["5B.4","5B.1"]},{"title":"Thailand and Australia agree to boost Trade & Tourism cooperation","publisher":"Public Relations Department, Thailand","date":"March 6, 2024","url":"https://thailand.prd.go.th/en/content/category/detail/id/2078/iid/266801","summary":"Thailand and Australia agreed to expand cooperation in trade, investment, tourism, technology, and innovation, and to improve the Thailand-Australia FTA. This supports a fairer, more open commercial environment for firms and job creation.","question_ids":["5B.4","5B.1"]},{"title":"Thailand sees at least $22 billion investment pledges in 2024","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"June 14, 2024","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/thailand-sees-at-least-22-billion-investment-pledges-in-2024-3484417","summary":"Reuters said the government expected at least 800 billion baht in investment applications, with Q1 applications up 31 percent year on year. This is positive for investment and property-rights openness, though still politically sensitive.","question_ids":["5B.4","5B.1"]},{"title":"Pros and cons of expanding foreign rights to property ownership","publisher":"Nation Thailand","date":"July 23, 2024","url":"https://www.nationthailand.com/business/property/40039924","summary":"Real-estate entrepreneurs argued that any liberalization needed strict anti-nominee and location safeguards, which signals that the reform was not yet obviously fair or complete. This is indirect negative evidence because it shows the policy needed guardrails to avoid distortion and abuse.","question_ids":["5B.4"]},{"title":"Longer property leases for foreigners to boost slumping market: REIC","publisher":"Nation Thailand","date":"July 23, 2024","url":"https://www.nationthailand.com/business/property/40039922","summary":"REIC backed looser foreign ownership rules but warned they had to be carefully regulated to avoid long-term harms.
